```{r script-info, include=FALSE}
# This script was used to create the following figures:
# Figure 2c: UMAP of CytoTRACE2 potency categories
# Figure 2d: CytoTRACE2 score by major cell type
# Figure 2e: patient-level CytoTRACE2 by disease stage, coloured by location
# Figure 2i: CytoTRACE2 of melanoma cells in primary UM by uveal location
# Supplementary Figure 4a: CytoTRACE2 by age class (within disease stage; and Fig. 2e coloured by age class)
# Supplementary Figure 4b: CytoTRACE2 by gender (within disease stage; and Fig. 2e coloured by gender)
# Supplementary Figure 4c: CytoTRACE2 of melanoma cells by secondary mutation (all tumours; and choroidal primaries only)
# Supplementary Table 2: stemness signature (top/bottom 50 genes correlated with CytoTRACE2)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 7.5, fig.height = 6.5)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table); library(ggplot2); library(ggsignif); library(ggbeeswarm); library(scattermore); library(patchwork)
})
source("colors_2026b.R")

OBJ  <- "../new_data_2026b/Objects/full Dataset/final_Subtyping_iCNV_reclustered.qs2"
META <- "../new_data_2026b/full_meta_full.csv.gz"
CT   <- "../Outputs/CytoTRACE2_2026b"
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE); dir.create("tables", showWarnings = FALSE)

ORIGINS <- c("non-malignant", "primary", "metastasis")
LOC3 <- c("choroid", "iris", "ciliary body")   # ciliochoroidal (1 patient) not shown or tested
MUTS <- c("BAP1", "SF3B1", "EIF1AX")
MIN_CELLS <- 10   # a tumour/tissue (orig.ident) needs >= 10 cells of the set to be drawn and to enter its patient mean
SETS <- c(malignant = "Malignant cells", healthy_melanocyte = "Non-malignant melanocytes", all_cells = "All cells")
potency_labels <- c("Differentiated", "Unipotent", "Oligopotent", "Multipotent", "Pluripotent", "Totipotent")
potency_colors <- setNames(c("#9E0142", "#F46D43", "#FEE08B", "#E6F598", "#66C2A5", "#5E4FA2"), potency_labels)
AGES <- c("<40", "40-60", "≥60", "unknown")   # 40-60 = [40, 60)
age_colors <- setNames(c(unname(ageGroup_col[c("Young", "Middle", "Old")]), "grey30"), AGES)

nfmt <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "d", big.mark = ",")
wrap_cap <- function(x, width_in) paste(strwrap(x, floor(13 * width_in)), collapse = "\n")
thm <- theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8.5),
        plot.caption.position = "plot", plot.title.position = "plot")
save_gg <- function(p, id, w, h) {
  ggsave(file.path("figures", paste0(id, ".pdf")), p, width = w, height = h, device = cairo_pdf)
  ggsave(file.path("figures", paste0(id, ".png")), p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  p
}
signif_label_adj <- function(padj) sprintf("%s  adj. p %s",
  as.character(cut(padj, c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf), c("***", "**", "*", "ns"))),
  ifelse(padj < 2.2e-16, "< 2.2e-16", paste("=", trimws(formatC(padj, digits = 2, format = "g")))))

# x: one row per cell with orig.ident, Patient_nr, the grouping column and the value v.
# pts = one point per tumour/tissue (drawn); pat = one mean per patient and group (tested).
units <- function(x, grp) {
  pts <- x[, .(score = mean(v), n_cells = .N), by = c("orig.ident", "Patient_nr", grp)]
  stopifnot("an orig.ident sits in two groups" = !anyDuplicated(pts$orig.ident))
  pts <- merge(pts[n_cells >= MIN_CELLS], oi, by = "orig.ident")
  pat <- x[orig.ident %in% pts$orig.ident, .(score = mean(v), n_cells = .N), by = c("Patient_nr", grp)]
  list(pts = pts, pat = pat)
}
# Two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum on patient means for every pair of groups with >= min_pat patients.
pat_tests <- function(u, grp, levels, panel, min_pat = 3) {
  n_by <- table(factor(u$pat[[grp]], levels = levels)); lv <- names(n_by)[n_by >= min_pat]
  if (length(lv) < 2) return(data.table())
  rbindlist(lapply(combn(lv, 2, simplify = FALSE), function(pr) {
    a <- u$pat[get(grp) == pr[1], score]; b <- u$pat[get(grp) == pr[2], score]
    data.table(panel = panel, group1 = pr[1], group2 = pr[2], n_patients1 = length(a), n_patients2 = length(b),
               median1 = median(a), median2 = median(b), p = suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(a, b)$p.value))
  }))
}
with_bh <- function(tt) { if (nrow(tt)) tt[, padj := p.adjust(p, "BH")]; tt }   # BH over the comparisons of one panel
box_panel <- function(u, grp, levels, tt, title, ylab, fill = NULL, colour = NULL, colour_values = NULL,
                      colour_name = NULL, shape = NULL, size_cells = FALSE, note = NULL, width = 7.5) {
  pts <- u$pts[get(grp) %in% levels]; pat <- u$pat[get(grp) %in% levels]
  levels <- levels[levels %in% pts[[grp]]]
  pts[, x := factor(get(grp), levels = levels)]
  n_pt <- table(pts$x); n_pa <- table(factor(pat[[grp]], levels = levels)); small <- names(n_pa)[n_pa < 3]
  tt <- tt[group1 %in% levels & group2 %in% levels]
  cap <- paste(c(sprintf("One point per tumour/tissue (orig.ident, >= %d cells); Wilcoxon rank-sum on patient means, two-sided, BH-adjusted within the panel (%d tests). n = orig.ident (patients).",
                         MIN_CELLS, nrow(tt)),
                 if (length(small)) sprintf("Not tested (< 3 patients): %s.", paste(small, collapse = ", ")), note),
               collapse = " ")
  m <- list(); if (!is.null(colour)) m$colour <- as.name(colour)
  if (size_cells) m$size <- as.name("n_cells"); if (!is.null(shape)) m$shape <- as.name(shape)
  fixed <- c(if (is.null(colour)) list(colour = "black"), if (!size_cells) list(size = 2.2))
  p <- ggplot(pts, aes(x, score)) +
    (if (is.null(fill)) geom_boxplot(fill = "grey85", alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6)
     else geom_boxplot(aes(fill = x), alpha = 0.45, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE)) +
    do.call(geom_quasirandom, c(list(mapping = do.call(aes, m), width = 0.22, alpha = 0.85), fixed)) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = setNames(sprintf("%s\nn = %d (%d pat.)", levels, as.integer(n_pt), as.integer(n_pa)), levels)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.06 + 0.11 * nrow(tt)))) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = ylab, caption = wrap_cap(cap, width)) + thm
  if (nrow(tt)) p <- p + geom_signif(comparisons = unname(Map(c, tt$group1, tt$group2)), annotations = signif_label_adj(tt$padj),
                                     step_increase = 0.11, tip_length = 0.01, textsize = 3.2, vjust = -0.2)
  if (!is.null(fill)) p <- p + scale_fill_manual(values = fill)
  if (!is.null(colour)) p <- p + scale_colour_manual(values = colour_values, name = colour_name,
                                                     breaks = intersect(names(colour_values), unique(as.character(pts[[colour]]))))
  if (size_cells) p <- p + scale_size_continuous(name = "Cells", range = c(1.5, 6), breaks = c(100, 1000, 5000, 10000), labels = nfmt)
  if (!is.null(shape)) p <- p + scale_shape_manual(values = c(primary = 16, metastasis = 17), name = NULL)
  p
}
tests <- list()
```

# {.tabset}

## Overview

**Purpose**: infer the developmental potential (stemness) of every cell of the atlas with CytoTRACE2 and compare it between
disease stages, uveal locations, secondary mutations, age classes and genders; derive the stemness signature used on the
Xenium sections and the external datasets.

**Input**: raw UMI counts of the integrated atlas object and its per-cell metadata (`../new_data_2026b/`).

**CytoTRACE2** (version 1.1.0, `species = "human"`) is run on the raw counts one library (`Sample`) at a time, so its KNN
smoothing never mixes libraries. Potency categories: Differentiated (0-0.167) to Totipotent (0.833-1).

**Statistics**: the unit of replication is the patient. Boxplots draw one point per tumour/tissue (`orig.ident`, >= 10 cells)
and test the patient means (mean over all cells of the set) with a two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum test between every pair of
groups with >= 3 patients. P-values are BH-adjusted within each panel (Suppl. Fig. 4a/b by stage: over all comparisons of the
figure) and shown as "adj. p". Melanocytic cell set = melanoma cells of tumours and melanocytes of non-malignant tissue.

**Stemness signature**: Pearson r of the CytoTRACE2 score with log1p(CP10k) expression of every gene detected in >= 1% of
the cells of a set; the 50 most positively (Top) and 50 most negatively (Bottom) correlated genes.

**Outputs**: `figures/` (PDF + PNG, named by figure ID), `tables/` (tests, signatures). Scores, per-gene correlations and
the atlas UMAP are cached under `../Outputs/CytoTRACE2_2026b/` and re-read when present.

```{r compute}
score_file <- file.path(CT, "cytotrace2_scores.qs2")
umap_file  <- file.path(CT, "atlas_umap.csv.gz")
cor_file   <- function(s) file.path(CT, sprintf("gene_cor_%s.csv", s))
if (!all(file.exists(c(score_file, umap_file, cor_file(names(SETS)))))) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(Seurat); library(CytoTRACE2); library(Matrix) })
  dir.create(file.path(CT, "per_library"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  obj <- qs2::qs_read(OBJ, nthreads = 1)
  obj[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(obj[["RNA"]])
  counts <- LayerData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
  cm <- obj@meta.data[, c("Sample", "origin", "Malignant", "majority_celltype")]
  if (!file.exists(umap_file)) {
    e <- Embeddings(obj, "umap")
    fwrite(data.table(cell = rownames(e), UMAP_1 = e[, 1], UMAP_2 = e[, 2]), umap_file)
  }
  rm(obj); invisible(gc())
  if (!file.exists(score_file)) {
    # about one core per 500 cells: with more cores, small libraries leave empty KNN chunks and CytoTRACE2 fails
    res <- rbindlist(lapply(split(colnames(counts), cm$Sample), function(cells) {
      f <- file.path(CT, "per_library", paste0(cm[cells[1], "Sample"], ".qs2"))
      if (file.exists(f)) return(qs2::qs_read(f, nthreads = 1))
      r <- cytotrace2(as.matrix(counts[, cells, drop = FALSE]), is_seurat = FALSE, species = "human",
                      ncores = min(8L, max(1L, length(cells) %/% 500L)), batch_size = 10000, seed = 14)
      r <- data.table(cell = rownames(r), r)
      qs2::qs_save(r, f, nthreads = 1)
      r
    }))
    res[, Sample := cm[cell, "Sample"]]
    stopifnot(setequal(res$cell, colnames(counts)), !anyNA(res$CytoTRACE2_Score))
    qs2::qs_save(res, score_file, nthreads = 1)
  }
  res <- qs2::qs_read(score_file, nthreads = 1)
  score <- setNames(res$CytoTRACE2_Score, res$cell)[colnames(counts)]
  # Pearson r from sparse sums (no dense genes x cells matrix)
  norm <- counts %*% Diagonal(x = 1e4 / colSums(counts)); norm@x <- log1p(norm@x)
  dimnames(norm) <- dimnames(counts)
  cells_of <- list(malignant = rownames(cm)[cm$Malignant == "Malignant"],
                   healthy_melanocyte = rownames(cm)[cm$origin == "non-malignant" & cm$majority_celltype == "Melanocytes"],
                   all_cells = rownames(cm))
  for (s in names(SETS)) if (!file.exists(cor_file(s))) {
    X <- norm[, cells_of[[s]], drop = FALSE]; y <- score[cells_of[[s]]]; n <- length(y)
    sx <- rowSums(X); sxx <- rowSums(X^2); sxy <- as.numeric(X %*% y)
    r <- (n * sxy - sx * sum(y)) / sqrt((n * sxx - sx^2) * (n * sum(y^2) - sum(y)^2))
    g <- data.table(gene = rownames(X), correlation = r, pct_expressed = rowSums(X > 0) / n)[pct_expressed >= 0.01][order(-correlation)]
    stopifnot(abs(g$correlation[1] - cor(as.numeric(norm[g$gene[1], cells_of[[s]]]), y)) < 1e-8)
    fwrite(g, cor_file(s))
  }
  rm(counts, norm); invisible(gc())
}
```

```{r load}
meta <- fread(META, select = c("cell", "orig.ident", "Sample", "Patient_nr", "origin", "majority_celltype", "Malignant",
                               "primary_location", "location", "secondary_mutation", "Gender", "Age_atDiagnosisY"))
ct <- qs2::qs_read(score_file, nthreads = 1)
d <- merge(meta, ct[, .(cell, CytoTRACE2_Score, CytoTRACE2_Potency)], by = "cell")
stopifnot(nrow(d) == nrow(meta), !anyNA(d$CytoTRACE2_Score), all(d$origin %in% ORIGINS))
# Age is a patient attribute: non-malignant samples take their patient's age at diagnosis.
age <- unique(d[!is.na(Age_atDiagnosisY), .(Patient_nr, age = Age_atDiagnosisY)])
stopifnot("a patient has two ages" = !anyDuplicated(age$Patient_nr))
d[age, age := i.age, on = "Patient_nr"]
d[, age_class := factor(fcase(is.na(age), "unknown", age < 40, "<40", age < 60, "40-60", default = "≥60"), levels = AGES)]
oi <- unique(d[, .(orig.ident, location, Gender, age_class)])
stopifnot("orig.ident metadata not unique" = !anyDuplicated(oi$orig.ident))
mel <- d[Malignant == "Malignant" | majority_celltype == "Melanocytes"]
```

The atlas has `r nfmt(nrow(d))` cells from `r uniqueN(d$Sample)` libraries, `r uniqueN(d$orig.ident)` tumours/tissues and `r uniqueN(d$Patient_nr)` patients.

## Fig. 2c

```{r fig2c, fig.width = 9.5, fig.height = 7.5}
um <- merge(fread(umap_file), d[, .(cell, CytoTRACE2_Potency)], by = "cell")
stopifnot("UMAP misses cells" = nrow(um) == nrow(d))
um[, pot := factor(CytoTRACE2_Potency, levels = potency_labels)]
setorder(um, pot)   # higher potency drawn on top
n_pot <- table(um$pot)
p <- ggplot(um, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, colour = pot)) + geom_scattermore(pointsize = 2.8, pixels = c(2400, 2400)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = potency_colors, drop = FALSE, name = "CytoTRACE2 potency",
                      labels = sprintf("%s (%s)", names(n_pot), nfmt(as.integer(n_pot)))) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4))) +
  labs(title = "CytoTRACE2 potency", x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2",
       caption = sprintf("All %s cells (%d libraries, %d patients).", nfmt(nrow(um)), uniqueN(d$Sample), uniqueN(d$Patient_nr))) +
  thm + theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
save_gg(p, "Fig2c_cytotrace_potency_umap", 9.5, 7.5)
```

```{r fig2d, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 7}
save_gg(p, "Fig2d_cytotrace_violin_celltype", 11, 7)
```

## Fig. 2e

Melanocytic cells by disease stage; points coloured by location, sized by cell number.

```{r fig2e}
u_or <- units(mel[, .(orig.ident, Patient_nr, origin, v = CytoTRACE2_Score)], "origin")
tests$f2e <- with_bh(pat_tests(u_or, "origin", ORIGINS, "Fig2e_cytotrace_by_origin_location"))
n_shared <- length(intersect(u_or$pat[origin == "non-malignant", Patient_nr], u_or$pat[origin == "primary", Patient_nr]))
note_or <- sprintf("Melanoma cells of tumours, melanocytes of non-malignant tissue. %d patients give both a non-malignant and a primary unit.", n_shared)
save_gg(box_panel(u_or, "origin", ORIGINS, tests$f2e, "CytoTRACE2 by disease stage", "Mean CytoTRACE2 score",
                  colour = "location", colour_values = location_colors, colour_name = "Location", size_cells = TRUE, note = note_or),
        "Fig2e_cytotrace_by_origin_location", 7.5, 6.5)
```

## Suppl. Fig. 4 {.tabset}

### a, b: age class and gender

Age class and gender compared within each disease stage (melanocytic cells, points coloured by location). BH over all
comparisons of the figure. Age classes need >= 2 patients to be tested; unknown age is shown, not tested.

```{r sfig4ab, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 6.5}
by_stage <- function(col, levels, test_lv, fill, id, title, note, min_pat = 3) {
  loc_all <- intersect(names(location_colors), unique(oi$location))
  us <- lapply(setNames(ORIGINS, ORIGINS), function(o)
    units(mel[origin == o, .(orig.ident, Patient_nr, g = as.character(get(col)), v = CytoTRACE2_Score)], "g"))
  tt <- rbindlist(lapply(ORIGINS, function(o) pat_tests(us[[o]], "g", test_lv, paste0(id, ":", o), min_pat)))
  tt[, padj := p.adjust(p, "BH")]
  ps <- lapply(ORIGINS, function(o) {
    p <- box_panel(us[[o]], "g", levels, tt[panel == paste0(id, ":", o)], o, if (o == ORIGINS[1]) "Mean CytoTRACE2 score" else NULL,
                   fill = fill, colour = "location", colour_values = location_colors, colour_name = "Location")
    p$layers[[2]]$show.legend <- TRUE   # every location key in every panel, so patchwork collects one legend
    p + labs(caption = NULL) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9)) + guides(fill = "none") +
      suppressMessages(scale_colour_manual(values = location_colors, name = "Location", drop = FALSE, limits = loc_all))
  })
  cap <- sprintf("One point per orig.ident with >= %d cells, coloured by location; Wilcoxon rank-sum on patient means within each stage, two-sided, BH-adjusted across all %d comparisons in the figure. n = orig.ident (patients). %s",
                 MIN_CELLS, nrow(tt), note)
  nlv <- sapply(ORIGINS, function(o) sum(levels %in% us[[o]]$pts$g))
  print(save_gg(wrap_plots(ps, nrow = 1, widths = nlv, guides = "collect") +
                  plot_annotation(title = title, caption = wrap_cap(cap, 13), theme = thm), id, 14, 6.5))
  tt
}
tests$s4a <- by_stage("age_class", AGES, AGES[1:3], age_colors, "SFig4a_cytotrace_age_by_stage",
                      "CytoTRACE2 by age class within disease stage",
                      sprintf("%s Unknown age (%d patients) shown, not tested.", note_or, uniqueN(d[is.na(age), Patient_nr])), min_pat = 2)
tests$s4b <- by_stage("Gender", c("F", "M"), c("F", "M"), gender_col, "SFig4b_cytotrace_gender_by_stage",
                      "CytoTRACE2 by gender within disease stage", note_or)
```

Fig. 2e with the points coloured by age class and by gender (tests as Fig. 2e).

```{r sfig4ab_origin, fig.width = 15, fig.height = 6.5}
                   colour = "age_class", colour_values = age_colors, colour_name = "Age at diagnosis", size_cells = TRUE, note = note_or)
p_gen <- box_panel(u_or, "origin", ORIGINS, tests$f2e, "CytoTRACE2 by disease stage, gender", "Mean CytoTRACE2 score",
                   colour = "Gender", colour_values = gender_col, colour_name = "Gender", size_cells = TRUE, note = note_or)
save_gg(p_age, "SFig4a_cytotrace_origin_age", 7.5, 6.5) | save_gg(p_gen, "SFig4b_cytotrace_origin_gender", 7.5, 6.5)
```

### c: secondary mutation

Malignant cells of primary and metastatic tumours by secondary mutation, coloured by gender.

```{r sfig4c}
u_mut <- units(d[Malignant == "Malignant" & secondary_mutation %in% MUTS,
                 .(orig.ident, Patient_nr, secondary_mutation, v = CytoTRACE2_Score)], "secondary_mutation")
u_mut$pts <- merge(u_mut$pts, unique(d[, .(orig.ident, origin)]), by = "orig.ident")
tests$s4c <- with_bh(pat_tests(u_mut, "secondary_mutation", MUTS, "SFig4c_cytotrace_secondary_mutation_gender"))
save_gg(box_panel(u_mut, "secondary_mutation", MUTS, tests$s4c, "CytoTRACE2 by secondary mutation",
                  "Mean CytoTRACE2 score, malignant cells", fill = second_mutations_col, colour = "Gender",
                  colour_values = gender_col, colour_name = "Gender", shape = "origin",
                  note = sprintf("Primary and metastatic tumours: %d of the BAP1 points are metastases.",
                                 u_mut$pts[secondary_mutation == "BAP1" & origin == "metastasis", .N])),
        "SFig4c_cytotrace_secondary_mutation_gender", 7.5, 6.5)
```

### c: secondary mutation, choroidal primaries

Choroidal primary tumours only, so that uveal location does not confound the comparison. One point per patient (mean over
its malignant cells), BH over the 3 tests of the panel.

```{r sfig4c_choroid, fig.width = 6.5}
pat <- d[Malignant == "Malignant" & origin == "primary" & primary_location == "choroid",
         .(score = mean(CytoTRACE2_Score), secondary_mutation = secondary_mutation[1], n_mut = uniqueN(secondary_mutation)), by = Patient_nr]
stopifnot("a patient has two secondary mutations" = all(pat$n_mut == 1))
pat <- pat[secondary_mutation %in% MUTS][, x := factor(secondary_mutation, levels = MUTS)]
n_pa <- table(pat$x)
tt_ch <- rbindlist(lapply(combn(MUTS, 2, simplify = FALSE), function(g) {
  a <- pat[x == g[1], score]; b <- pat[x == g[2], score]
  data.table(panel = "SFig4c_cytotrace_choroid_pUM_secondary_mutation", group1 = g[1], group2 = g[2], n_patients1 = length(a),
             n_patients2 = length(b), median1 = median(a), median2 = median(b), p = suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(a, b)$p.value))
}))
tests$s4c_choroid <- with_bh(tt_ch)
cap <- "Malignant cells of choroidal primary tumours. One point per patient (mean CytoTRACE2 score over its malignant cells); Wilcoxon rank-sum on patient means, two-sided, BH-adjusted within the panel (3 tests). n = patients."
p <- ggplot(pat, aes(x, score)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = x), alpha = 0.45, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_quasirandom(width = 0.22, size = 2.2, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_signif(comparisons = unname(Map(c, tt_ch$group1, tt_ch$group2)), annotations = signif_label_adj(tt_ch$padj),
              step_increase = 0.11, tip_length = 0.01, textsize = 3.2, vjust = -0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = second_mutations_col) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = setNames(sprintf("%s\nn = %d", MUTS, as.integer(n_pa[MUTS])), MUTS)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.4))) +
  labs(title = "CytoTRACE2 by secondary mutation, choroidal pUM", x = NULL, y = "Mean CytoTRACE2 score, malignant cells",
       caption = wrap_cap(cap, 6.5)) + thm
save_gg(p, "SFig4c_cytotrace_choroid_pUM_secondary_mutation", 6.5, 6.5)
```

```{r write_tests, include = FALSE}
out <- rbindlist(tests)[, .(panel, comparison = paste(group1, "vs", group2), n_patients1, n_patients2,
                            median_patient_mean1 = median1, median_patient_mean2 = median2, p, p_adj_BH = padj)]
fwrite(out, "tables/tests_cytotrace2.csv")
```

## Suppl. Table 2

Stemness signature of malignant cells: the 50 genes most positively (Top) and most negatively (Bottom) correlated with the
CytoTRACE2 score. The same signature is also written for non-malignant melanocytes and for all cells
(`tables/stemness_signature_<set>_top50.csv`).

```{r stable2, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 11}
sig <- lapply(setNames(names(SETS), names(SETS)), function(s) {
  g <- fread(cor_file(s))
  out <- rbind(g[order(-correlation)][1:50][, direction := "Top"],
               g[order(correlation)][1:50][, direction := "Bottom"])[, .(gene, correlation, direction)]
  fwrite(out, sprintf("tables/stemness_signature_%s_top50.csv", s))
  out
})
n_mal <- d[Malignant == "Malignant", .N]
ggplot(sig$malignant, aes(correlation, reorder(gene, correlation), fill = direction)) + geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ factor(direction, c("Top", "Bottom")), scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Top = "firebrick3", Bottom = "steelblue4"), guide = "none") +
  labs(title = sprintf("Stemness signature, malignant cells (n = %s)", nfmt(n_mal)), x = "Pearson r with CytoTRACE2 score", y = NULL) +
  thm + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))
```
